$comment: Logical components inside the ontology-builder app (plan 0002). Paths are relative to the repository root and stay under apps/ontology-builder/. 'web' talks to 'api' over HTTP only (generated client), never by import. Only 'evaluation' may refer to the answer-key path.

components.name: model
components.responsibility: Defines the LinkML schema of every record and validates records against it.

components.name: store
components.responsibility: Reads and writes the files of one ontology dataset, atomically.

components.name: sources
components.responsibility: Splits Markdown documents and user statements into registered source units.

components.name: llm
components.responsibility: Calls Claude or replays recorded responses, and estimates tokens and cost.

components.name: extraction
components.responsibility: Turns source units into validated proposed elements with evidence and levels.

components.name: ingestion
components.responsibility: Runs one ingestion or on-demand extraction, resumable and all-or-nothing.

components.name: governance
components.responsibility: Applies review, authoring and governance actions under the role and status rules, recording each decision.

components.name: release
components.responsibility: Builds the raw and governed release files from the records.

components.name: vcs
components.responsibility: Commits the changed files of one dataset path to the local git working copy.

components.name: workflows
components.responsibility: Runs the app's use cases (create, ingest, review, save, publish) across the components below it.

components.name: api
components.responsibility: Exposes the use cases as a localhost JSON API and serves the built front end.

components.name: cli
components.responsibility: Exposes the use cases as ontology-builder commands.

components.name: evaluation
components.responsibility: Scores a live ingestion of the pet manuals against the answer key.

components.name: web
components.responsibility: Renders the review GUI in the browser and talks to the API only over HTTP.
